roadmap_stages.name: Preparation & Foundation
roadmap_stages.description: Establish API Gateway, core auth middleware, container registry, and CI/CD pipelines.
roadmap_stages.success_metric: 100% gateway route coverage and baseline telemetry operating

roadmap_stages.name: Low-Risk Service Extraction
roadmap_stages.description: Extract the least-coupled services first: few outgoing dependencies, so the lowest blast radius.
roadmap_stages.success_metric: Zero downtime cutover with full shadow-traffic validation
roadmap_stages.rollback_condition: Latency spike > 200ms or HTTP 5xx error rate > 0.5%

roadmap_stages.name: Core Domain Extraction
roadmap_stages.description: Migrate moderately coupled domain services and introduce transactional outbox patterns.
roadmap_stages.success_metric: 99.99% data consistency verified across event boundary
roadmap_stages.rollback_condition: Distributed transaction mismatch or DB replication lag > 2s

roadmap_stages.name: High-Coupling & Database Split
roadmap_stages.description: Extract the most coupled services last and decouple their shared monolith tables into isolated schemas.
roadmap_stages.success_metric: Complete removal of direct database joins across service boundaries
roadmap_stages.rollback_condition: Data integrity mismatch during dual-write verification

roadmap_stages.name: Stabilization & Monolith Retirement
roadmap_stages.description: Decommission monolithic routes and optimize microservice resource allocations.
roadmap_stages.rollback_condition: Unmapped legacy route invocations detected in logs
